mapper.select: wo.order_no AS work_order_id, wo.order_title, a.device_name AS relate_device, a.order_desc AS work_desc, a.alarm_content, wo.deadline, wo.order_status, hm.method AS handle_method, pr.order_context AS handle_explain, vr.verify_status, vr.verification_result AS verify_decision, vr.verify_opinion, pi.image_url AS attachment FROM work_order wo LEFT JOIN alarm a ON wo.alarm_id = a.alarm_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM process_record pr1 WHERE pr1.process_id IN (SELECT MAX(process_id) FROM process_record GROUP BY order_id) ) pr ON wo.order_id = pr.order_id LEFT JOIN handling_methods hm ON pr.method_id = hm.method_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM verification_records vr1 WHERE vr1.verification_id IN (SELECT MAX(verification_id) FROM verification_records GROUP BY order_id) ) vr ON wo.order_id = vr.order_id LEFT JOIN process_images pi ON pr.process_id = pi.process_id WHERE wo.order_no = #{id}
